solves: Shows several people in a short space, as a row of overlapping nph-avatar pieces, with the count of who does not show, read as one image by the name of the group.
use_when: To show who takes part in something, such as owners, members or participants, without listing everyone.
Show up to the 5th avatar; whoever does not show enters the count.
Turn on the count when there are more people than avatars, because the total must show.
sm in a list and in the select; md in a header, card and table row; lg in a profile.
Give the group a label with the names and the total, because the avatars are not read.
do_not_use_when: For a single person: use nph-avatar.
As the list of people with their names: the group does not replace it.
To space avatars without overlap: nph-avatar-stack already brings avatar/overlap.
To mix sizes in the group: the group has a single size and writes it on every avatar.
Past the 5th avatar: put whoever does not show in the count.

size.constraint: The Figma property size, the same sizes as nph-avatar. Reflects because the internal CSS selects the count by it. The group writes it on every child avatar, also when a child changes its own afterwards, so a size on a child does not survive. A value outside the list draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

count.constraint: How many people do not show, the Figma properties `mostrar contagem` and `contagem`. A whole number from zero up. Above zero, the group draws +N at the end, overlapping the last avatar; zero, or no attribute, draws no count. A negative number, a broken number or text draws nothing and emits console.error in development. The name is a technical proposal of P78.

label.constraint: The name of the group, already localized, with the names and the total, such as Ana, Bruno, Carla and 3 more. It becomes the aria-label of the host, which is the role img. A name the consumer puts on the host with aria-label or aria-labelledby also counts. Without any name, the group draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

slot.constraint: The nph-avatar children, each with its own src, from the 2nd to the 5th. The Figma properties `mostrar 3º`, `mostrar 4º` and `mostrar 5º` are the number of children, not properties. Fewer than two or more than five avatars, a child that is not an nph-avatar and an avatar with a label of its own render anyway and warn in development.

size.choose_when: sm in a list and in the select; md in a header, card and table row; lg in a profile.

count.choose_when: With a count when there are more people than avatars; without one when every person shows.

default.changes_for_user: A row of avatars, each over the previous one, and the +N count over the last one. The group has no state of its own: no hover, no focus, no disabled and no animation.

business_rules: The group has a single size: it writes its size on every child avatar.
Each avatar goes over the previous one by avatar/overlap, and the count goes over the last avatar.
The separation between avatars is the border of each nph-avatar; the group draws no ring, background or border of its own.
The group is read as one image, by its label; the avatars and the count are hidden from the screen reader.
The group does not check that label and count agree: whoever uses it writes both.
ai_hints: Use nph-avatar-stack to show who takes part without listing everyone; for a single person, use nph-avatar.
Put from two to five nph-avatar children in the group, each with its own src, and the rest in count.
Set size on the group, not on the avatars: the group writes it on each one.
Give the group a label with the names and the total, already localized; leave the avatars without label.
Keep label and count in agreement: the group does not check them.
Next to a text, such as the team name, give the space space/inline yourself.

accessibility.semantics: The host is one image, role img, named by label. The slot and the count sit in one aria-hidden wrapper, so the avatars and the count are not read, even an avatar with a label of its own. The group is never focusable.
accessibility.accessible_name: The label: the names and the total, such as Ana, Bruno, Carla and 3 more, written by whoever uses the group, in its language. aria-label or aria-labelledby on the host also count.
accessibility.focus: The piece does not receive focus and has no tabindex. When the group opens the list of people, the focus belongs to the control around it.
accessibility.contrast: The +N text, color/muted-foreground on color/muted, passes 4.5:1 in light and dark, in every brand; nph-avatar-stack.test.ts measures it by hand until the accessibility gate of P72 arrives.
accessibility.color_alternative: Each person shows by photo or person icon, and the total shows as text.

invalid_combinations: A size outside sm, md and lg — the group draws nothing.
A count that is not a whole number from zero up — the group draws nothing.
No name — no label, no aria-label and no aria-labelledby: the group draws nothing.
Fewer than two or more than five avatars — the group renders and warns in development.
A child that is not an nph-avatar — it is not part of the group; the group warns in development.
An avatar with a label of its own — the group still reads only its own name and warns in development.
anti_patterns: Leaving the group without a name with the people and the total.
Using the group for a single person.
Using the group in place of the list of people with their names.
